decision: design-critique: not warranted for #6298, because this is a test-isolation fix only (no new check, gate, refusal or production behaviour change) with concrete acceptance criteria

governingRule.description: Before issue:ingest record arc or design-critique: not warranted, because ...

whyWinner: The fix only makes session-start tests build their own env instead of inheriting Claude host markers; the in-tree pattern (hooks/dispatcher.test.ts, #6227) already settles the shape, so an arc would re-derive it
revisitTrigger: If isolating a test needs a production code change or a new env parameter
